issue.title: Module "arrow.arrow" has no attribute 'get'
issue.body:
## Issue Description

I enter the two first lines from the tutorial:

import arrow
arrow.get('2013-05-11T21:23:58.970460+07:00')

I get:
AttributeError: module 'arrow.arrow' has no attribute 'get'   
## System Info

- 🖥  **Windows 10**
- 🐍  **3.7.3**
- 🏹  **0.17.0**:
